purpose: Teach: あきらめる/リーズナブル/数時間/いえよ/一遍/しきりに/たいして/そのうえ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、難しいことでもあきらめるのは早いわよ
lines.en: Sho, giving up when things get tough isn't the answer.
lines.style: Warm and steady, leaning slightly forward. Gentle conviction — not lecturing, guiding. A soft opening, then firmness on the core idea. The tone of someone who believes in him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、リーズナブルなお絵描きセット買ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got a new art set—it was really affordable.
lines.style: Bright, eager rush on the main words. Small pride in the accomplishment. Quick pace, like he can't wait to share it. Ends on a note of wanting approval.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとお祖父ちゃん、数時間お話していらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father and grandfather have been talking for hours.
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly wondering. A measured pace that invites him to think about what that means. Soft, not pushing — planting a seed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖父ちゃんに「ありがとうっていえよ」って教わったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandpa taught me to say thank you when things matter.
lines.style: Earnest and clear, with a hint of discovery in the voice. Small pause before 'thank you' — he's proud of learning this. Straightforward, sincere delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと一遍博物館に行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, why don't we go to the museum together sometime?
lines.style: Warm invitation, eyes soft. A light upward turn at the end — opening the door without pushing. Tender but not uncertain. The kindness of including him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、しきりに絵を描きたくなるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I keep wanting to draw more and more.
lines.style: Energetic, building momentum. A small laugh underneath — he's surprised at himself. Quick cadence, genuine delight. The voice of someone discovering he loves something.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、新しい習い事、たいして難しくないかもね
lines.en: Sho, your new lessons might not be as hard as you think.
lines.style: Knowing warmth. A small reassurance tucked in the observation. Calm pace, the tone of someone who has seen him do harder things. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お絵描きしたよ。そのうえ、お歌も歌ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I drew pictures—and I even sang a song too!
lines.style: Triumphant final report, eager to show the day's harvest. Slight lift on 'even'—proud of the bonus. Quick, bright delivery. The happiness of showing what he's made.
